name: Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd
title: Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd - 544133 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone Q4 revenue INR 282 cr (+33% YoY) and EBITDA margin 10.6%, but consolidated EBITDA only INR 0.3 cr with rising inventory and receivables; supply-side signals are capacity additions, not discipline.

capex.quote: The plant becoming operational has resulted in some additional depreciation in Q4

triggers.label: Inventory build-up for Hyderabad ramp
triggers.quote: Inventory build-up, with our Hyderabad plant ramping up while the Gurgaon plant continues to run in parallel, we have seen a temporary build-up in inventory.

triggers.label: Tritium revenue ~3x targeted
triggers.quote: we expect revenue scale up to happen almost to the tune of 3x and reduction in EBITDA losses by 25%

triggers.label: Tritium EBITDA breakeven Q4 FY27
triggers.quote: we are firmly on our path for EBITDA breakeven at Tritium in Quarter 4 of FY '27

triggers.label: Receivables up on Q4 ramp
triggers.quote: Our account receivables have increased but this is largely a function of sharp revenue ramp-up

guidance.quote: we expect revenue scale up to happen almost to the tune of 3x
EBITDA breakeven at Tritium in Quarter 4 of FY '27
we are still looking to do INR 50 crores in business in this financial year from non-telecom BESS
We are really trying to increase that to 20% in FY '27

red_flags.label: Consolidated EBITDA negative for FY26
red_flags.quote: This year, consolidated EBITDA remains negative at INR 103 crores

red_flags.label: Inventory and receivables build
red_flags.quote: we have seen a temporary build-up in inventory

red_flags.label: Management on working capital: 'without stress'
red_flags.quote: we continue to have headroom to fund both our growth investments and our working capital cycle without stress
